notes: Native performance pass, both platforms. Chat streaming now repaints at a steady ~30 Hz instead of per network chunk — only the growing bubble re-renders while the transcript, composer and scaffold stay perfectly still; the final answer is committed to the thread in one write. Typing recomposes only the composer, editing only the bubble being edited. Code blocks highlight once on completion instead of re-colouring every frame mid-stream. Timestamp formatters cached process-wide. On iOS: per-token whole-screen invalidation replaced with an off-main accumulator + 30 Hz flush, per-message render cache, Equatable bubbles that skip untouched rows, shared cached formatters, off-main SQL bootstrap and export, one-write store syncs, and animations that settle when hidden. Same design, same features — the interface just got weightless.
